integrity: Exact finite exhaustive computation and independent characteristic-two Cartier / Weil-coefficient agreement; no external independent audit or proof assistant certificate.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to geometrically smooth bidegree-(4,3) filling divisors over F2; arithmetic types and embedded ambient equivalence, not a classification of all abstract genus-six curves; prior enumeration not claimed new. Exact enumeration and Gröbner computations rely on replayable program; potential unindexed equivalent work remains.
title: Four Jacobian isogeny classes and the sharp 2-rank bound for binary filling biquartic-cubic curves
